title.zh: 操作系统是怎么和硬件说话的
title.en: How the OS Talks to Hardware

desc.zh: 程序里写一句 read()，几微秒后数据就从硬盘或网卡那里来了，可用户程序碰不到任何硬件。这句话怎么穿过那堵墙，找到对的驱动和设备，再把结果送回来？九个可以动手的模型：一条指令在哪个特权级会被拦下，系统调用的寄存器约定，一次进出内核要多少周期，读设备寄存器为什么贵，中断、轮询和 NAPI 各花多少 CPU，描述符环多大才不丢包，驱动怎么和设备配对，一次 read() 在每一层花多久，以及 epoll 和 io_uring 每次 I/O 要几次系统调用。
desc.en: A read() in your program brings data back from a disk or a network card within microseconds, yet a user program cannot touch any hardware. How does that one line cross the wall, find the right driver and device, and bring the result back? Nine hands-on models: which instruction traps at which privilege level, the system-call register convention, the cycles of one kernel crossing, why reading a device register is expensive, the CPU cost of interrupts, polling and NAPI, how large a descriptor ring must be not to drop packets, how drivers bind to devices, where one read() spends its time layer by layer, and how many system calls epoll and io_uring make per I/O.

title.zh: 特权级：CPU 每条指令都查「你现在是谁」
title.en: Privilege levels: the CPU checks who you are on every instruction

desc.zh: 在 ring 3 或 EL0 上，读写端口、关中断、换页表的指令一执行就被硬件拦下；Linux 把它变成 SIGSEGV 或 SIGILL。
desc.en: At ring 3 or EL0, port I/O, disabling interrupts or switching page tables traps in hardware; Linux turns it into SIGSEGV or SIGILL.

zh: 操作系统怎么和硬件通信
en: how does the OS talk to hardware

title.zh: 系统调用：程序故意触发的一次异常
title.en: The system call: an exception the program raises on purpose

desc.zh: syscall 或 svc 把 CPU 切到内核的固定入口；编号放在 rax（arm64 是 x8），内核按编号查表。
desc.en: syscall or svc jumps to a fixed kernel entry; the number sits in rax (x8 on arm64) and the kernel looks it up in a table.

title.zh: 一次进出内核要多少周期

desc.zh: 进出本身一两百个周期；KPTI 让每次多付几百个，批量才能把门票摊薄。
desc.en: The crossing itself is a hundred or two cycles; KPTI adds hundreds more, and only batching spreads the cost.

title.zh: 设备寄存器：物理地址上的一段「假内存」
title.en: Device registers: a stretch of pretend memory

desc.zh: 写寄存器发出去就走，读寄存器要等一次 PCIe 来回，约半微秒；所以驱动尽量不读设备。
desc.en: A register write is posted; a read waits a PCIe round trip of about half a microsecond, so drivers avoid reading devices.

title.zh: 中断走过的路：向量、上半部、下半部
title.en: The path of an interrupt: vector, top half, bottom half

desc.zh: 一次写变成本地 APIC 上的向量号，核心按 IDT 跳进处理函数；上半部只做最急的事，其余交给软中断或中断线程。
desc.en: A write becomes a vector at the local APIC, the core jumps through the IDT; the top half does the urgent part, softirqs or threaded handlers do the rest.

title.en: NAPI: interrupt first, then poll in batches

desc.zh: 包来得密时每包一次中断会让核心活锁；NAPI 在第一个中断后关掉中断、每次最多轮询 64 个包。
desc.en: At high packet rates an interrupt per packet livelocks the core; NAPI masks interrupts after the first and polls up to 64 packets at a time.

desc.zh: 驱动在内存里摆一圈描述符，网卡自己把数据写进去；两个只往前走的计数器追上了就满，满了就丢包。
desc.en: The driver lays out a ring of descriptors and the NIC writes data into them; two free-running counters meet when it is full, and then packets drop.

desc.zh: 设备给出的 I/O 虚拟地址经 IOMMU 翻译，每个设备只看得见映射给它的几页。
desc.en: Device addresses are I/O virtual addresses translated by the IOMMU; each device sees only the pages mapped for it.

title.en: The driver model: match, probe, bind

desc.zh: 总线把设备的 ID 和驱动的表逐条比对，对上了调用 probe()；缺依赖时返回 -EPROBE_DEFER，等别的绑定成功后重试。
desc.en: The bus compares device IDs with each driver table and calls probe() on a match; a missing dependency returns -EPROBE_DEFER and is retried after another bind.

title.zh: 一次 read() 穿过的每一层

desc.zh: 页缓存命中不到一微秒；不命中时穿过文件系统、块层和驱动，在最快的盘上软件已经和设备一样慢。
desc.en: A page-cache hit takes under a microsecond; a miss crosses the file system, block layer and driver, and on the fastest drives the software is as slow as the device.

title.zh: 少走几次门：epoll 与 io_uring

desc.zh: epoll 一次告诉你哪些连接有数据；io_uring 用两个共享的环一次交一批、收一批。
desc.en: epoll reports which connections are ready in one call; io_uring uses two shared rings to submit and reap a batch at a time.

title.zh: 绕开内核，以及虚拟机里的设备
title.en: Kernel bypass and devices in virtual machines

desc.zh: DPDK、SPDK 和 RDMA 把队列直接交给用户程序；virtio 和 SR-IOV 把设备交给虚拟机。
desc.en: DPDK, SPDK and RDMA hand queues straight to a user program; virtio and SR-IOV hand devices to virtual machines.

title.zh: 前沿：io_uring 的安全代价、Rust 驱动、用户态
title.en: The frontier: io_uring security, Rust drivers, user space

desc.zh: 2026 年 11 月：io_uring 是内核里最常被攻击的部分之一；Linux 6.18 收进了 Rust 写的 Binder，7.4 删掉了 C 版本。
desc.en: November 2026: io_uring is among the most attacked parts of the kernel; Linux 6.18 merged the Rust Binder and 7.4 removed the C one.

title.zh: 程序卡在 I/O 上时问的三件事
title.en: Three questions when a program is stuck on I/O

desc.zh: 时间花在链上的哪一段，每次 I/O 走了几次门，CPU 是在干活还是在等。
desc.en: Which link of the chain takes the time, how many crossings each I/O makes, and whether the CPU is working or waiting.
